fallback: If media or graphical display fails, continue boot and retain serial/text progress.
packaging_steps: Import Init.mp4 from the source repository without overwriting the source asset.
Rebrand video frames with tools/artwork/rebrand-init-video.sh in a build environment with ffmpeg and DejaVu Sans.
Rasterize the octopus SVG to PNG with a deterministic image tool and record SHA-256.
Stage the PNG and branded MP4 at the declared ISO paths.
Stage the Lua OSD script and ensure mpv can read the progress state.
Verify all required files and hashes before ISO publication.
progress_semantics: Progress is driven by completed initialization/install events, never by elapsed time or static menu echoes.
